newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said short-term money supply exceeded demand on the market, causing active early-maturing contracts to fall today. Volume for late-maturing contracts was very thin.

Major securities houses and brokerages were major net borrowers on the market today, taking in money for speculation on the domestic A share market, traders said. State banks continued to be net lenders.
"The rates are likely to consolidate at low levels in the next few days because of sufficient money supply on the market," one trader said.
